Name: Customizable Baby and Children
Author: nraittanna
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#a64d79]Customizable Baby and Children[/color][/b]
[/size]
[size=3]This mod lets the player completely customize their kids looks. Check inside the mod's folder or the description below for all previews of the configurable options.

[/size][size=3]If you don't want to configure each kid and instead want them automatically look like your spouse, or want kids in multiplayer to look different, please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9513][b]this mod[/b][/url] instead.
[/size]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][size=5][b]:[/b]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patc[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]her[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ must be installed. (Note: The mod will work without the last, but it's highly recommended for easier configuration).[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿[/size][size=3]Download the mod and unzip it.[/size]
[*][size=3]Place the folder [b][CP] Customizable Baby and Children[/b] in your Mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][b]﻿Compatibility:[/b][/size]
[size=3]If you have any other mods that change your children appearance, only one will load.
[/size][b]
